Still unsettled. A 2004 winter loop logged 4 h 23 min up, 1 h 19 min down and 6 h 29 min car to car, which fits the itinerary's 6.5 h total and the descent_text's ~1.3 h down; the 2021 snow ascent gives 2.7 h up and 1.3 h down (about 4 h). Neither supports partner_requirements' 3-3.5 h round trips, but the two sources disagree with each other on the total (6.5 vs ~4 h), so no figure is adopted.
